articles.title: Zugwise: Domain-Aware Game Reconstruction for Digitizing Handwritten Chess Scoresheets
articles.raw_summary: Digitizing handwritten chess scoresheets has been studied as a handwriting-recognition problem: read the move in each box and check that it is legal. articles.title: Cleaning an Agent's History Hurts When the World Still Holds the Error
articles.raw_summary: Tool-using language-model agents accumulate histories of their own mistakes, and a system that compacts, repairs or hands off such a history decides what it says about those mistakes while their effects stay in the world. Prior work cleans the history at a fixed world, where showing a corrected step and saying it is done move together. We ask whether the same correct content helps or hurts depending on how the history states it and what the world holds. articles.title: Together Compiler: Continual Compilation for AI Inference
articles.raw_summary: Today's AI workloads are rapidly changing: new models are released more often, model architectures are increasingly diverse, and traffic distributions change frequently. The challenge we face at Together AI is continual optimization for these changing workloads. Compiling a deployment into an optimized forward pass is a challenge that is well-suited for agent hill-climbing. articles.title: Rational Use of Time for Social Coordination in Humans and AI
articles.raw_summary: All social interactions are situated in time. articles.title: Adversarial Risk in the Generative AI Era Necessitates Dropping the Small Epsilon Ball

articles.title: StructRL: Model-Free Reinforcement Learning with Replay Graphs
articles.raw_summary: StructRL turns the experience collected during reinforcement learning into an explicit replay graph. Once the graph contains a path to the task goal, dynamic programming selects actions on the observed part of the state space; these actions form a graph policy that is defined only where the required transitions have been observed. StructRL transfers these actions to model-free learners: as action preferences for a DQN Q-model and as target directions along shortest observed paths for a SAC actor. articles.title: Thompson Sampling using Prior-fitted Diffusion Transformers
